project.title: Diatom-based biorefinery for rice mill wastewater treatment and biomass valorization into high-value bioproducts
project.description: This project developed an integrated, diatom-based biorefinery that utilizes unsterile rice mill wastewater for diatom-dominant biomass cultivation and efficient effluent treatment. The resulting biomass was valorized to produce high-value bioproducts such as fucoxanthin and bio-silica for biotechnological applications, promoting resource recovery within a circular bioeconomy framework. The microbial community dynamics of this integrated system was monitored via metagenomic sequencing at multiple time points during the rice mill wastewater treatment process.
